title: User function body — case arms with variable := prefix then return — pass 21
sourceUrl: internal: Tier 4.3 pass 21 case-arm branch-shape relaxation
license: internal regression test, no external reference
problemDescription: Function body is a case where every arm is `[variable := expr; return variable]`. Pass 21 relaxes TryInlineCaseAsMux to accept `[Operation*, ReturnStatement]` arms (mirror of pass-20's if/else relax). Per-arm PushScope isolates writes so arm A's tmp binding doesn't leak into arm B.
